headline: A delay program is possible into San Francisco; Boston arrivals are slowed.

items.text: No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any United hub. The seven United hubs reporting so far today are at 84% on time or better.
The FAA's operations plan says a ground delay program is possible for flights into San Francisco (SFO) until 9:00 PM PT. It is not in effect.

A ground delay program is in effect for flights into Boston (BOS) until 12:30 AM ET because of heavy traffic, with delays averaging 41 minutes and up to 96 minutes. The FAA's plan lists a possible ground stop or ground delay program for flights into Newark (EWR) tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET; it is not in effect.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying into Boston, check your flight status before heading to the airport.
